claim.scope: Native F32 restricted-frame Q/K affinity diagnostic and authenticated one-block BF16 source capture only; no acting, warp, full attention, full T0 preprocessing or speed claim.
claim.adversary: ROBUST for authenticated T0 first-frame affinity measurement; VULNERABLE if interpreted as actor tracking or an acting controller. Read-only same-lineage review is correlated, not independent replication.
claim.rollback: Omit the opt-in query diagnostic and capture CLIs; production runtime is unchanged.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: bounded GPU diagnostic and authenticated source capture; no production defaults changed.

capture.hook: Block 0 first cache append before attention; img.q_rope and img.k_rope.
capture.input_storage: F32 lossless expansion of exact BF16 Q/K; native and source score arithmetic is F32.
capture.scope_limit: Consumes authenticated saved native image/text/vector/RoPE preblock tensors. Latent/noisy-latent/timestep records are authenticated but not consumed; this is not independent noise-to-preblock replay or a clean-input experiment.
capture.receipt_order_fix: Validate exact tensor inventory/count, headers, shape and contiguous extents; JSON key insertion order is not semantic.

verification.dod_signal: 15 CPU tests, native release build, 7 CPU-only native admission cases and 4 paired native/source GPU cases pass. Both post-drain metric audits pass; all score arrays are byte-identical.
verification.gpu_commands: Exact build and guarded capture/native/source/qualification argv and output digests are bound by the external index; T0 qualifier used --verify-model-capture.
verification.repository_graph_validation: The skill template and scripts/validate-landmark-graph.sh are absent in this checkout; use existing packet style, JSON parsing, exact path review, whitespace checks and live evidence digest verification. No graph-validator execution or clean rebuild is claimed.

execution.audit_scope: Independent CPU metric audits and per-head summaries run only after the GPU diagnostic drain; no production data path is added.
execution.source_capture_limit: Existing source block capture has post-forward diagnostic checks and exports; no one-drain synchronization guarantee is claimed for that capture.

memory.limit: Polling misses between-sample transients. Named bytes exclude opaque Metal/runtime allocations; short native runs establish neither native peak nor speedup.

findings.interpretation: Do not apply an all-head query warp. Heads 12/15 are exploratory selections on one saved state. Within-frame self preference is not cross-frame correspondence; authored rectangles are not validated actor masks and 144-key self mass is not full-attention probability.

continuation.next_falsifier: Evaluate frozen head/layer selections on held-out saved states before attempting query transport.
later_required_controls: causal rollout and visible acting review
continuation.known_geometric_limit: A 32-pixel latent cell does not isolate glove from wrist/page; 2D translation or rotation does not specify head yaw.

evidence_index.availability: External SSD; missing/mutated bytes reopen dependent claims.

limitations: Inherited linked-object compile provenance and complete runtime bytes are not reconstructed.
Sampled guard peaks miss between-poll transients; short native jobs are not a measured native peak.
Source block capture uses existing post-forward diagnostic checks/exports; no one-drain guarantee for that capture.
Native diagnostic has one terminal wait and two post-wait readbacks; CPU metric audits and per-head summary run after that drain.
